core_obligations: Show the rule (g : Y' -> Y, e) |-> (g^*alpha cap - : Z_e(Y') -> Z_{r+e}(X')) factors through rational equivalence and defines a bivariant class c(alpha) in A^{-r}(X -> Y) (proof lines 2731-2740). Factorization: by lemma-action-gysin (tag 0H6E) and chow-lemma-factors-through-rational-equivalence (tag 0B7A) (proof lines 2732-2734). Bivariance: the resulting operation on chow groups is a bivariant class by chow-lemma-bivariant-weaker (tag 0F9A) applied with the push-pull compatibility lemma-action-push-pull (tag 0H6B), the base change compatibility lemma-action-base-change (tag 0H68), and the Gysin compatibility lemma-action-gysin (tag 0H6E) (proof lines 2735-2739).
proof_roadmap: Factor through rational equivalence via the Gysin compatibility and the Chow Homology factorization lemma (proof lines 2732-2734).
Apply the bivariant-weaker criterion with the push-pull, base change and Gysin compatibilities of the action (proof lines 2735-2739).
